analysis: This 65-69-year-old female with ECOG 1, smoking history, and recurrent neutropenia/anemia develops late-onset multi-organ failure (day 139): severe hyponatremia, pneumonia, pneumonitis, restrictive cardiomyopathy, and dehydration. The rapid progression from cytopenias to cardiopulmonary and neurologic compromise suggests a systemic inflammatory or drug-induced process with poor therapeutic reserve. High mortality risk due to progressive multi-system dysfunction and limited compensatory mechanisms.
evidences: Recurrent grade 2-3 neutropenia with late-onset pneumonia and pneumonitis
